deadline.value: International applicants should apply by February 1, 2027 for priority review; the standard deadline is June 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall - Priority U.S. CITIZEN February 1 INTERNATIONAL February 1

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to this field.

gre_general.value: GRE General is required for applicants entering with a bachelor's degree only; preferred scores are 146 verbal and 160 quantitative.
gre_general.quote: the applicant must have an official Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general test result report submitted to The Graduate College

also.quote: official GRE (general test) with a preferred score of 146 or higher for verbal and 160 or higher for quantitative

supervisor.value: Admission does not need a supervisor; the program director is the initial advisor for each admitted student.
supervisor.quote: The Ph.D. program director serves as initial advisor of each student accepted into the program

funding.value: Paid assistantships are limited in number.
funding.quote: A limited number of paid graduate assistantships are available

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a bachelor's in civil engineering or with a master's in civil engineering.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in Civil Engineering, or a closely related discipline from a regionally accredited university | Master's degree in Civil Engineering, or a closely related discipline from a regionally accredited university
